archetypes.name: dyn-bgjob-lineage
archetypes.rationale: The cutover separates immutable launch identity from retry lineage across changing HEADs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Step 8 wrapper start/finalize split and persisted launch envelopes. Verify retries select exactly the next tier, preserve stable recovery lineage, and bind each launch to its own HEAD and diff fingerprint. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
